blocks.headline: No room for *20 feet*? Do this instead.
blocks.narration: The rule says run a generator twenty feet from the house. But what if your yard isn't that big?
blocks.scene: exterior view from the street of a small one story house very close to the house next door, narrow strip of grass between them, winter, bare trees

blocks.headline: As far as you can. *Out in the open.*
lines: o|Not under a porch, carport or eave
blocks.narration: Put it as far from the house as your yard allows, out in the open. Never under a porch or carport, and never in the garage.
blocks.scene: an orange and black portable gas generator with wheels sitting on frosty grass in a small backyard, wooden privacy fence behind it, exterior daytime

blocks.headline: Point the *exhaust away*.
lines: o|Away from your house and the neighbor's
o|Close the windows on that side
blocks.narration: Point the exhaust away from your house and your neighbor's, and close the windows and doors on that side.
blocks.scene: exterior side wall of a small white wooden house with closed windows, frosty lawn in front, overcast winter sky

blocks.headline: Carbon monoxide alarms *inside*.
lines: y|Battery, or plug-in with battery backup
y|Alarm goes off? Shut it down, get out
blocks.narration: Keep carbon monoxide alarms inside, battery or plug-in with a battery backup. If one goes off, shut the generator down and get everyone outside.
blocks.scene: a white carbon monoxide alarm on a living room wall above a lamp, cozy small home, evening light

blocks.headline: Buying one? Get *auto shutoff*.
lines: g|Look for UL 2201 or PGMA G300 on the box
blocks.narration: Buying a generator? Get one with carbon monoxide shutoff. Look for U.L. twenty-two oh one, or P.G.M.A. G three hundred, on the box.
blocks.scene: a new portable generator in its cardboard box in a hardware store aisle, bright store lighting
blocks.plate_prompt: photorealistic documentary photograph inside a small-town hardware store, a new portable generator in its cardboard box sitting on the concrete floor of an aisle, shelves of tools on both sides, bright fluorescent store lighting, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain

blocks.headline: No yard? *Skip the gas.*
lines: b|A battery power station is safe indoors
b|Or head to a warming center
blocks.narration: No yard at all? Skip the gas generator. A battery power station has no exhaust and is safe indoors. Or head to a warming center.
blocks.scene: a portable battery power station on a kitchen table charging a phone and powering a small lamp, dark winter evening

blocks.headline: Comment *READY*
blocks.narration: Comment ready, and we'll message you the ninety day kit. Thirteen printable pages, nine dollars.
blocks.scene: a printed home emergency checklist on a clipboard on a kitchen table beside a mug of coffee and a pencil, morning window light
